nodes.summary: For a finite type $\iota$ and a vector $x \in \mathbb{R}^\iota$, this is the map $v \mapsto v \cdot x = \sum_{i \in \iota} v_i x_i$, as a continuous linear functional $\mathbb{R}^\iota \to \mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: The dot product with a fixed vector

nodes.summary: Let $E$ and $F$ be real Hilbert spaces, let $g : E \to F$ be differentiable at $x \in E$, and let $f : F \to \mathbb{R}$ be differentiable at $g(x)$. Then $\nabla (f \circ g)(x) = Dg(x)^* \, \nabla f(g(x))$, where $Dg(x) : E \to F$ is the Fréchet derivative of $g$ at $x$ and $Dg(x)^*$ is its adjoint.
nodes.title: The chain rule for gradients

nodes.summary: Let $\iota$ be a finite type, let $f : \mathbb{R}^\iota \to \mathbb{R}$ and $g, z \in \mathbb{R}^\iota$, and suppose $f$ is Fréchet differentiable at $z$ with derivative $w \mapsto w \cdot g$. Then for every $v \in \mathbb{R}^\iota$, the function $t \mapsto f(z + t v)$ on $\mathbb{R}$ has derivative $v \cdot g$ at $t = 0$.
nodes.title: Directional derivative from the gradient

nodes.summary: Let $\iota$ be a finite type, let $f : \mathbb{R}^\iota \to \mathbb{R}$ and $g, z \in \mathbb{R}^\iota$, and suppose that, for the sup norm on $\mathbb{R}^\iota$, $f$ is Fréchet differentiable at $z$ with derivative $v \mapsto v \cdot g$. Then $f$, viewed as a function on the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^\iota$ with inner product $\langle v, w \rangle = \sum_{i \in \iota} v_i w_i$, has gradient $g$ at $z$.
nodes.title: A Fréchet derivative given by a dot product is a gradient

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
